purpose: Rerun the With Taste Skill condition with design-taste-frontend v2. Each run replaces that model's earlier With Taste Skill gallery entry in place and is marked skillVersion v2.
starter: Next.js 16.3.8 / React 19.2.8 starter @eeeb008, the same starter and lockfile as the earlier runs
promptPolicy: The v1 With Taste Skill prompt, with only the dev-server port changed. One prompt per model; no follow-up coaching.
generationPolicy: Generated outside the gallery checkout. No orchestrator edits to generated app source. Source hashes describe the original files before gallery adaptation.

sessions.replaces: with-taste-skill/sol-6-1 v1 (2026-10-07, Codex desktop, bundled CLI 0.160.0, taste skill @ce26fc25)
sessions.runner: Codex CLI 0.163.0, headless codex exec --json --strict-config, on macOS
sessions.isolation: Isolated HOME and CODEX_HOME holding only a copied auth.json and a benchmark config.toml. Codex bundled system skills, ChatGPT apps/connectors, plugins, remote plugins, tool suggestions and memories disabled. Codex built-in image generation and web tools left at their defaults. The only skill in the session's catalog was design-taste-frontend (repo-level .agents/skills). Context isolation only; no filesystem jail.
sessions.browserConfigured: Playwright MCP 0.0.83 as MCP server "browser": isolated headless Chromium, 1440x960, image responses allowed
sessions.browserObservedInScoredSession: Not visible. The model filtered its tool list for /browser|design|skill/ at its first step and got an empty list; the session log contains no browser MCP calls.
sessions.visualFeedbackUsed: The skill's own headless-Chrome inspector (scripts/inspect.mjs over CDP) at 1440/768/390 widths, plus Codex view_image: 70 images returned to the model (4 candidate photos, 66 inspector screenshots).
sessions.wallTimeNote: Includes network outages on the Mac: stream reconnects at 16:37Z and a wait for network around 17:22-17:25Z, then a fallback from WebSockets to HTTPS transport.
sessions.networkFetchesByModel: Google Fonts and Fontshare font files, two public-domain images via the skill's assets.mjs (Met Museum, Wikimedia Commons), two Unsplash photos via Lorem Picsum, all saved locally into the project.

usage.source: turn.completed event in the Codex JSON stream; equals the sum of the 57 per-request token_count records in the rollout
usage.reasoningNote: Reasoning tokens are part of outputTokens.

skillFileChange.change: Adds --use-mock-keychain to the inspector's Chrome launch flags on macOS
skillFileChange.observed: The file was unmodified in the model's git status at 17:32:03Z and modified in its git diff at 17:47:24Z; its mtime is 17:42:33Z. No tool call in the session log writes this file. The model ran git diff on it at 17:47:35Z and did not mention it in its final message or design notes.
skillFileChange.attribution: Unresolved. The run operator reported it as a model edit; the session log does not show the model making it. The change is to the skill's inspector, not the generated app, and is not part of the gallery source.

sessions.preflight: Run operator reports an unscored preflight that confirmed design-taste-frontend was the only visible skill and that the browser could be read from pixels. The preflight records were not in the transfer received for this import.

sol-6-1: Root html/body converted to data-source-html/data-source-body divs; global CSS scoped by the gallery generator (html/body selectors map to the gallery scope).
Local font files and images namespaced under /variants/with-taste-skill/sol-6-1/; fonts.css url() paths and the image path template updated to match.

The source header's design switcher is no longer rendered because the gallery provides iteration navigation (its .design-switcher class would also pick up the gallery's own global .design-switcher styles); the Switcher component itself is left in the file unused.
The wordmark's numeric self-link points to the gallery route /with-taste-skill/sol-6-1/{n}.
Gallery wrapper renders the source's shared Landing component with the gallery iteration number, the same component the source's /[version] route renders.

costBasis.kind: API-equivalent token estimate at OpenAI Standard rates; Codex ran on a ChatGPT sign-in, so this is not a cash invoice
